messages.author: sven.dahl.102050@plumgatecreamery.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new Benelux and Nordic chapter space. Good to see familiar names here as we prep for the spring preview.

messages.author: annelie.dahl.100603@gorsemerecheese.example
messages.text: Thanks Radek. I am putting together the schedule for our regional meet-up in Alkmaar next month. Please let me know if you have agenda items.

messages.author: annelie.lindqvist.100351@aldermerecheesemonger.example
messages.text: The herd management seminar we discussed is fully booked. Looking forward to connecting with everyone in Gouda.

messages.author: bram.bauer.100482@quillpost.example
messages.text: Given the current travel restrictions, we should look into shifting our spring tastings to an online format. I can help coordinate the tech side.

messages.author: annelie.dahl.100603@gorsemerecheese.example
messages.text: Agreed, Vikram. ICF staff is setting up the virtual portal now. We will share details on the online grading credentials soon.

messages.author: anneke.steiner.100719@womackfarmstead.example
messages.text: The online grading course actually went quite well for our apprentices here in Nykøbing Mors. Still miss the in-person cut and curd sessions though.

messages.author: sven.dahl.102050@plumgatecreamery.example
messages.text: Planning has started for the 2022 symposium. Let us hope we can finally meet face-to-face in Aarhus next year.

messages.author: annelie.dahl.100603@gorsemerecheese.example
messages.text: In-person registration is officially open and competition entries are already climbing faster than expected. Make sure your submissions are in early.

messages.author: ingrid.lindqvist.101787@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Affineurs in our cellar are rushed off their feet this summer with demand hitting new highs. Great to see the artisan boom in full swing.

messages.author: karin.meyer.100495@umberfenfinecheese.example
messages.text: We are looking for a few more volunteers to help judge the regional cheese awards in autumn. Reach out if your schedule allows.

messages.author: sven.dahl.102050@plumgatecreamery.example
messages.text: Venue contracts for next year are locked in. Thanks to everyone who helped review the catering and tasting room capacities.

messages.author: annelie.lindqvist.100351@aldermerecheesemonger.example
messages.text: Sponsorship holds are completely filled for the upcoming conference. Staff is stretched thin managing the sheer volume of attendees.

messages.author: jing.zhang.101447@postfield.example
messages.text: The monger masterclass in Gouda drew a record crowd last weekend. Thanks to everyone who stopped by our tasting tables.

messages.author: sven.dahl.102050@plumgatecreamery.example
messages.text: With the recent cost inflation hitting our small producers, please remember that ICF has hardship dues waivers available for qualifying members.

messages.author: annelie.dahl.100603@gorsemerecheese.example
messages.text: We are organizing a support session next Tuesday focusing on farmstead succession and closure counseling. Please pass the word to anyone who needs it.

messages.author: sven.dahl.102050@plumgatecreamery.example
messages.text: Costs are finally stabilizing across the board. Our next focus is helping the next generation of makers navigate the updated raw-milk aging rules.

messages.author: annelie.dahl.100603@gorsemerecheese.example
messages.text: Thanks Radek. The traceability working group is putting together a compliance checklist that should make the new regulations much easier to digest.

messages.author: annelie.lindqvist.100351@aldermerecheesemonger.example
messages.text: We will review the final traceability draft at the autumn meeting in Gouda. See you all there.
